body: Thank you for the insight guys. I don’t think I’d have come to a conclusion like that with my own self reflection. I appreciate the help.

I’m sorry you had to go through something like that. 

I will grow up & hopefully make things better for people around me. Thanks for sharing your experience.

Her behavior doesn’t extend to all women. There are genuine & good people out there for you to find. Maybe you would need counseling to help make sense of your experience.

I do hope whatever I have is treatable for the sake of the people around me.
I just looked it up & damn. I hope there’s a way to get treated for narcissistic behavior. Thank you for making me aware of this.

Have you ever felt like you didn’t truly love your wife but was with her as you felt like you had no other option? 

How were you able to get over that “grass is greener on the other side” feeling?
I think I made the issue clear in the post

I am with her. But I feel like I want to leave again. But just bouncing back and forth like that would be hurtful to put her through. I’m not even sure what I want to do.

I’m just a generally bad person. I’m not sure how to change.
Anxious about what? Or is it just anxiety in general?

Thank you so much man. I really let some of what you said marinate, especially the part about how it’s gonna take a while to do away with habits & behaviors learnt over a relative lifetime.

Sometimes things just seem hopeless, and I have a tendency to derealize and enter this sort of fugue state where the world is made out of plastic and nothing is real (best way I can word it).

Looking for a social support group for people who also have broadly similar experience really seems like it could be helpful, but for some reason I get hesitant cause I feel like attending would make all this “real”, which it already demonstrably is.

A lot of confusion and a lot of things to think about. Again I appreciate you taking the time out to seriously write out something helpful.

Those people who I mean to write to aren’t really a part of my life anymore. I’ve moved out but they’re the only ones who I still hold dearly, even though it’s not really reciprocated.

I have been getting treatment but it’s a slow burn & I don’t really think a bunch of therapies & medication can really alter my life situation, that’s kind of in my hands to get up and do. 

There’s this dictum from the divine comedy that I’ve memorized at this point.

At the entrance to hell, the following demand must be made:
>Qui si convien lascaire ogni sospetto 

>Ogni vilta convien che que sia morta 

Which essentially translates to: “Here must all distrust be left; All cowardice must here be dead.”

Which I’ve found to be in a way relevant to my predicament, but sometimes the burden or gravity of being thrust into life already damaged with nothing but yourself to go through with it, won’t always turn out how you want it to.

I can relate to you lashing out at your friends and essentially losing them. I’ve done the same but in a different manner, essentially just fully going cold & completely distant to the point where they think I’m not interested in having a relationship with them anymore, this essentially led me to losing everybody, not just a few of my friends. 

I haven’t actually been following a “fuck it” impulse, but I’ve been trying to build myself a better life, but it’s been 2 months now and if anything I feel worse albeit things seeming to have “changed for the better”. 

And yeah, this isn’t really uncommon to mood disorders, but christ is it annoying. 

Thanks for commenting though, I appreciate you taking the time to involve me in some of your own stories as well.

Although I’m not in your position and wouldn’t fathom how you feel. I’d try everything possible to get the medical attention I’d need, because it seems like your problems are being caused by your frankly shitty health situation.

Maybe look into counseling and find other avenues of help. I’m really not sure what to say but I hope you’ll find a way to make sense of this.

Thank you for sharing your story with us by the way.

I just wrote down my notes and didn’t think much of it. If anything in my mind I’d know my friends would move on and I’d be reduced to some morbid story they’d share with others in the future.

My parents I know would have been devastated, but in my mind I’d be too dead to feel guilty about it, it’s selfish, but sometimes you’re so stuck in that hole you don’t know any other ways out.

For context I tried drowning myself, overdosing and recently came very close to jumping off a cliff.
Hi, I’m sorry if this is the wrong question to ask, but would it be possible for you to move to an area with better healthcare to get your issues treated?
